topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I had just watered the last of my roses when I noticed a truck parked by my neighbor’s, its bed loaded with fence posts and wiring. Mr. Thompson, who's always been friendly, not much past 60 and the kind of man who waves every morning, was unloading the materials with some help. I hadn't heard any mention of a fence, and it struck me as odd that he would suddenly decide to put one up. Our neighborhood has always been an open sort of place, with clear boundaries already defined by the natural layout. As I watched, I couldn’t help but wonder what had changed, and if it was something I should be aware of.
